# Dorian Award for Outstanding Broadway Play Revival

}}
The Dorian Award for Outstanding Broadway Play Revival is one of the main categories of Dorian Theatre Awards, given annually to the best revival of a play on Broadway by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association). The category was introduced in 2023 when the awards began honoring Broadway theatre.
